title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a worked example with a different currency symbol and rate style
body:
## Problem
All examples use abstract 'units'; some students relate better to a familiar currency and to monthly-quoted rates.

## Context
The maths is currency-free, but friendlier examples help beginners.

## Expected outcome
One extra worked example in `sessions/session-02/README.md` with a different loan size and a monthly-quoted rate, checked against the lesson functions.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/README.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Numbers come from running the lesson code
- [ ] Clearly labelled as made up and not advice

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: all-in cost with fees and insurance
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Fees and insurance change the true cost; Session 3 only handled one fee in the mini-project.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: step-up EMI and a prepayment penalty
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses a fixed EMI and free prepayment.

## Context
Roadmap milestones 2 and 3.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the EMI steps up each year and a penalty applies to lump sums, with the net saving shown.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint numbers reproduced
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: linked loan pictures
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the interest/principal stack, a prepayment kink and flat versus reducing cost; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GIF of at most 60 frames and 3 MB
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
